name: howto
title: The O-Cedar spin mop in five minutes
sub: Six steps from box to dry floor, from O-Cedar's use-and-care guidance and owner tips
footer: Sources: O-Cedar use-and-care and washing pages (as seen in search snippets; read your own manual).

items.head: Assemble and lock
items.body: Twist the handle sections together and lock the length. Press the head onto the frame until it clicks.

items.head: Fill the bucket
items.body: Water up to the line, plus any floor cleaner you like. Sealed floors only.

items.head: Dunk, then spin
items.body: Put the head in the basket and pump the pedal 5 to 7 times (O-Cedar). More pumps for hardwood.

items.head: Mop in lines
items.body: Work back toward the door. Rinse and re-wring when the head turns grey.

items.head: Pop the head off
items.body: Step on it to detach, so your hands stay clean.

items.head: Wash and dry flat
items.body: Machine or hand wash, no bleach or fabric softener, air dry. Replace about every 3 months.
